headline.en: CVC Credit prices second European CLO of 2026 at €400m
headline.zh: CVC Credit为2026年第二只欧洲CLO定价，规模4亿欧元

summary.en: CVC Credit priced its second European CLO of 2026, Cordatus XXXIX, at around €400m, with its in-house fund CVC CLO Equity IV taking the majority of the equity tranche. CVC said it has been the most active issuer in the European CLO market this year with 13 transactions totalling €4.7bn. The deal priced with a weighted average cost of debt of 181 basis points over the base rate and a single-A tranche at 180 basis points over.
summary.zh: CVC Credit为其2026年第二只欧洲CLO——Cordatus XXXIX定价，规模约4亿欧元，其内部基金CVC CLO Equity IV认购了该CLO大部分股权档。CVC表示，今年迄今其是欧洲CLO市场最活跃的发行人，共完成13笔交易，总额47亿欧元。该交易定价的加权平均债务成本为基准利率加181个基点，单A档定价为加180个基点。

items.source_headline: CVC prices second European CLO of 2026 at €400m

reason.en: A new €400m European CLO pricing by CVC Credit, with tight spreads and an in-house equity fund taking most of the equity; incremental sector evidence with no tracked manager involved.
reason.zh: CVC Credit新定价4亿欧元欧洲CLO，利差较窄且内部股权基金认购大部分股权；属增量行业证据，不涉及受跟踪管理人。

items.relevance_reason: CVC Credit's new European CLO pricing and tight spreads signal continued CLO issuance conditions in Europe, relevant to the tracked CLO sub-sector even though CVC is not a tracked manager.

headline.en: BlackRock: AI fears, not fundamentals, drive software loan markdowns
headline.zh: BlackRock：软件贷款减记源于AI担忧而非基本面

summary.en: Markdowns on software loans have accounted for roughly two-thirds of total unrealised losses in private credit since the fourth quarter of 2025, according to BlackRock's quarterly private credit outlook. The weighted average valuation of first-lien software loans fell from near par at the end of 2025 to around 97 per cent of cost in the second quarter of 2026. BlackRock said Lincoln International data shows the markdowns reflect uncertainty over AI-related disruption rather than broad deterioration in software fundamentals.
summary.zh: BlackRock的季度私募信贷展望显示，自2025年第四季度以来，软件贷款的减记约占私募信贷全部未实现损失的三分之二。第一留置权软件贷款的加权平均估值从2025年底的接近面值降至2026年第二季度约成本的97%。BlackRock表示，Lincoln International的数据显示，这些减记反映的是对AI相关颠覆的不确定性，而非软件基本面的广泛恶化。

items.source_headline: AI fears, not fundamentals, behind software markdowns

reason.zh: 已评估严重程度：有限；关联程度：行业。

items.relevance_reason: Software loan markdowns driving two-thirds of private credit unrealised losses affects valuation conditions for tracked credit managers and the private credit sub-sector.

headline.en: Deloitte survey finds private credit valuation lag as Apollo extends daily pricing
headline.zh: 德勤调查发现私募信贷估值滞后，Apollo扩大每日定价

summary.en: Deloitte's 24th Fair Valuation Pricing Survey, polling more than 100 fund groups, found 48 per cent refresh private credit valuations daily using observable market inputs, while only 4 per cent carry out a full daily update revisiting unobservable inputs, cash flow assumptions and methodology. The largest share, 39 per cent, do so quarterly. Earlier this month, Apollo began extending daily pricing across its $850bn credit business. The FCA and SEC have both raised concerns about private asset valuations.
summary.zh: 德勤第24次公允价值定价调查访问了100多家基金集团，发现48%的基金集团每日使用可观察市场输入更新私募信贷估值，但仅有4%进行每日全面更新，重新审视不可观察输入、现金流假设和方法论。占比最大的一部分（39%）按季度进行。本月早些时候，Apollo开始在其8500亿美元信贷业务中扩大每日定价。FCA和SEC均对私募资产估值提出担忧。

items.source_headline: Private credit growth piles pressure on valuations

reason.en: Deloitte survey data on valuation frequency and Apollo's extension of daily pricing across its $850bn credit business are incremental developments with no payment failure or franchise damage.
reason.zh: 德勤关于估值频率的调查数据以及Apollo在其8500亿美元信贷业务中扩大每日定价，属于增量进展，未出现支付失败或业务受损。

items.relevance_reason: Valuation and pricing frequency for private credit bear directly on tracked managers' credit vehicles and sector risk, with Apollo's daily pricing of its credit business a new fact.

headline.en: BlueOrchard and IFC target $2bn for emerging market private debt fund
headline.zh: BlueOrchard 与 IFC 拟为新兴市场私人债基金募资 20 亿美元

summary.en: BlueOrchard and the International Finance Corporation have teamed up on an evergreen private debt vehicle targeting $2bn for emerging market credit. Tokio Marine Group was the anchor investor in the $300m first close. Investors can subscribe and redeem on an ongoing basis subject to predefined redemption windows, with capital continuously recycled into new investments.
summary.zh: BlueOrchard 与国际金融公司（IFC）合作设立一只永续型私人债工具，目标为新兴市场信贷募资 20 亿美元。Tokio Marine Group 参与了 3 亿美元首次关账，并担任锚定投资人。投资者可在持续基础上申购和赎回，但受预设赎回窗口限制，资金持续循环投入新投资。

headline.en: Partners Group launches evergreen global multi-sector private credit income fund
headline.zh: Partners Group 推出常青全球多板块私人信贷收益基金

summary.en: Partners Group has launched an evergreen global multi-sector private credit income strategy for institutional and private wealth investors worldwide. The portfolio spans senior direct lending, credit secondaries, fund financing, royalties, opportunistic credit and liquid credit, targeting high single-digit to low double-digit returns. Partners Group manages $40bn in private credit and $186bn in assets under management.
summary.zh: Partners Group 推出面向全球机构及私人财富投资者的常青全球多板块私人信贷收益策略。该组合涵盖优先直接贷款、信贷二级市场、基金融资、特许权使用费、机会型信贷及流动性信贷，目标回报为高个位数至低双位数。Partners Group 管理 400 亿美元私人信贷及 1,860 亿美元资产。

items.source_headline: Partners Group launches private credit income fund
items.relevance_reason: Partners Group's new evergreen multi-sector private credit income fund expands a competitor platform in direct lending, secondaries and fund finance, relevant to tracked managers' fundraising and competitive conditions.

headline.en: FS KKR Capital Corp Declares $0.44 Quarterly and $0.20 Special Distribution
headline.zh: FS KKR Capital Corp 宣派每股 0.44 美元季度分派及每股 0.20 美元特别分派

summary.en: FS KKR Capital Corp (NYSE: FSK) said its board declared a fourth quarter 2026 distribution of $0.44 per share, payable on or about December 24, 2026 to holders of record on December 16, 2026. The board also declared a special distribution of $0.20 per share, representing a portion of estimated accumulated spillback income, payable on or about December 15, 2026 to holders of record on December 1, 2026. FSK said it will release third quarter 2026 results and host a call on November 5, 2026.
summary.zh: FS KKR Capital Corp（NYSE: FSK）表示，董事会宣派 2026 年第四季度分派每股 0.44 美元，将于 2026 年 12 月 24 日前后支付给 2026 年 12 月 16 日登记在册的股东。董事会还宣派每股 0.20 美元的特别分派，相当于估计累计溢出收益的一部分，将于 2026 年 12 月 15 日前后支付给 2026 年 12 月 1 日登记在册的股东。FSK 表示将于 2026 年 11 月 5 日发布 2026 年第三季度业绩并召开电话会议。

headline.en: ASIC halts offers in three more ASCF private credit funds
headline.zh: ASIC叫停另外三只ASCF私人信贷基金的发行

summary.en: Australia's ASIC has issued an interim stop order on the product disclosure statements for three private credit funds managed by Australian Secure Capital Fund: the ASCF Premium Capital Fund, ASCF Select Income Fund and ASCF High Yield Fund. The order prevents ASCF from offering, issuing, selling or transferring interests in the funds, with ASIC citing inadequate disclosure of loan portfolio and diversification metrics, a possible misleading and deceptive statement, and insufficient disclosure of an investor reserve account covering impairments and capital losses. As of 30 June the three funds had A$251.8m in assets under management.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚证券与投资委员会（ASIC）对Australian Secure Capital Fund（ASCF）管理的三只私人信贷基金——ASCF Premium Capital Fund、ASCF Select Income Fund和ASCF High Yield Fund——的产品披露声明（PDS）发出临时停止令。截至6月30日，这三只基金管理资产为2.518亿澳元。

items.source_headline: ASIC halts offers in three more private credit funds

reason.en: ASIC placed interim stop orders blocking offers in three ASCF private credit funds over alleged PDS disclosure failures, an adverse regulatory action in Australian private credit.
reason.zh: ASIC以涉嫌PDS披露失当为由，对三只ASCF私人信贷基金发出临时停止令，禁止其发行，是澳大利亚私人信贷领域的负面监管行动。

items.relevance_reason: ASIC's interim stop orders on three ASCF private credit funds and its wider crackdown signal rising Australian private credit regulatory and retail-distribution risk.
